incident-bot: PAGER — Severity: P2 - Smart routing anomaly detected for rollout rl-2361. High 5xx and malformed responses from canary variant. Affected region: eu-west-1. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/rl-2361

olivia: acked. I'm oncall for infra, scooping up triage. @sam @anya please join. Any immediate customer-visible impact? :eyes:

sam: on it. alert shows 5xx spike ~17:02 UTC, error rate ~3.1% for requests routed to variant model-pegasus-v2-canary. Can confirm increased latency tail too.

maria: support pinged — customers noticing truncated or garbled outputs for generation endpoints in EU. A few automated checks also failing. looks like decoding errors, not just timeouts.

chris: pulling router logs now. snippet:```
[2026-06-11T17:02:12Z] route_request id=abc123 user=acct-987 variant=model-pegasus-v2-canary -> decode_error: tokenizer_mismatch
[2026-06-11T17:02:12Z] fallback chosen=sticky_affinity variant=model-pegasus-v2-canary
[2026-06-11T17:02:13Z] route_request id=abc124 user=acct-987 affinity_lookup=sticky -> pinned_variant=model-pegasus-v2-canary
```
This looks like the fallback policy is sticky and clients are getting pinned to the failing canary after initial errors.

anya: quick ML note: the canary was a tokenizer-compatible rewrite of pegasus but with a different byte-level vocabulary. Decoding errors match that pattern. Should have been gated by a compatibility check during model onboarding.

olivia: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) disable sticky affinity 3) drain traffic from canary 4) revert affinity TTL. I'll run commands now.

olivia: `rctl rollout pause --id=rl-2361`

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2361: PAUSE request accepted by controller. current_traffic=10% -> pending 0%

sam: while pause propagates, we should stop the fallback behavior that re-pins users to the canary. `rctl routing update --policy rl-2361 --set fallback.mode=regional-prefer,affinity.enabled=false`

deploy-bot: routing policy rl-2361 updated: fallback.mode=regional-prefer, affinity.enabled=false, affinity.ttl=60s

chris: also nuking existing affinity cookies for the canary on the edge: `edgectl purge-affinity --variant=model-pegasus-v2-canary --region=eu-west-1`

edgectl: purge initiated, estimated completion 45s

sam: draining variant to 0: `rctl variant drain --model=model-pegasus-v2-canary --target=0% --force`

rctl: drain accepted. currently draining connections: 42 active -> will allow in-flight to finish (graceful).

maria: support note — I'm drafting a status: "We observed degraded text generation quality in EU for a small set of customers due to an experimental canary model. We've paused the rollout and routing is reverted to stable. No data loss. We'll update in 30m." Anyone want to add specifics?

james: please include that a subset (~12 accounts) saw garbled outputs and we've opened priority tickets. ETA for fix?

anya: root cause summary for now: canary tokenizer incompatible with customer tokenization expectations; fallback policy was configured with long sticky affinity (30d) so many clients got pinned to the bad variant after initial fallback attempts.

chris: config excerpt that caused this:```json
{
  "rollout_id":"rl-2361",
  "fallback":{
    "mode":"sticky_affinity",
    "affinity_ttl_days":30,
    "order":["local_variant","canary","stable"]
  }
}
```

olivia: action items I'm executing now: - ensure rollout remains paused - shorten affinity TTL to 60s (done) - disable sticky affinity (done) - drain canary (in progress) - add safety gating to onboarding pipeline for tokenizer compatibility (owner: @anya)

sam: monitoring metrics: error rate for eu-west-1 on generation endpoint pre-mitigation: 3.1% -> current: 0.4% (after purge + pause). token error ratio down from 0.7% to 0.05%.

maria: support to customers sent first note. I'll follow up with affected accounts directly. cc @james

james: queued 12 priority tickets and a temporary internal alert for any reappearance. Customers with SLAs flagged for escalation.

anya: long-term fixes: - add tokenizer compatibility check to model onboarding with unit tests - fail onboarding if mismatch - add canary pre-rollout smoke test that verifies decoding on a sample corpus per region. (I'll own PR)

chris: infra follow-ups: - make routing policy changes propagate faster (ack from edge teams) - add rollback guard that prevents sticky fallback for models with unknown compatibility. I'll file infra ticket.

olivia: handing over monitoring to @sam for the next shift. Sam, please watch EU metrics for 4 hours and confirm drain reaches 0; if errors resurface, escalate to oncall SRE lead.

sam: taking handoff. I'll keep 15m cadence checks for the first hour and post status.

deploy-bot: drain complete. model-pegasus-v2-canary traffic = 0%.

sam: verified traffic at 0% and no new affinity pins. Error rate stable ~0.05% in EU. Marking incident as mitigated for now. We should still follow up with a postmortem.

olivia: creating incident ticket in postmortem board and assigning owners: onboarding tests -> anya, routing guard -> chris, customer comms -> maria.

maria: post-incident customer message draft: "We paused an experimental model rollout after a limited set of users in EU experienced degraded outputs due to a tokenizer mismatch. The rollout is paused and traffic is routed back to the stable model. We're adding tests to prevent recurrence and will reach out to affected customers."

james: recommend outreach cadence: immediate note (sent), follow-up in 24h with technical details, and one-on-one for top SLAs.

olivia: thanks all. I'll update the timeline in the incident ticket and link logs + commands executed. We'll reconvene for a 30m async postmortem to collect notes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2361213200. Incident severity downgraded to P3. Postmortem required.
